. Our talks today are taking place during your visit to attend what is now
the Third Russia–Africa Summit
. I would like to thank you for finding the opportunity to come to Moscow once again.
🤝

our recent talks

A solemn reception was held on October 28 at the Kremlin in honour of the Heads of delegations – participants in the Third Russia–Africa Summit.
🎙
Welcoming remarks
by President of Russia Vladimir Putin at a reception in honour of the participants in
the Third Russia–Africa Summit
(Moscow, October 28, 2026)
💬
Vladimir Putin:
In its time,
the Soviet Union provided substantial assistance to the peoples of Africa
in breaking free from
the shackles of colonial dependence
and strengthening their sovereignty and national security.
The USSR helped develop
agriculture and energy, build new factories and enterprises, roads, schools and hospitals, which played a major role in overcoming the acute socioeconomic problems facing the newly independent African states.
🎓
Hundreds of thousands of Africans received a quality education and advanced knowledge in the USSR and later in Russia
, becoming highly qualified specialists in the professions most needed by their economies. They made, and continue to make, an invaluable contribution to their home countries. Russia continues, and will continue, this well-established practice of training African professionals.
Russia and Africa share a commitment to a just and
#MultipolarWorld
order
, free from diktat and based on the sovereign equality of states and respect for their values and cultures.
🤝
We work closely together in many international forums, including the
#UN
, coordinating our positions on key global and regional issues.
Russia seeks to make a tangible contribution to addressing the challenges facing Africa,
to take an active part in resolving ongoing crises and preventing new sources of tension on the continent, and to help combat terrorism and extremism, epidemics and hunger, while ensuring food, digital and environmental security.
☝️
There is a fine African proverb: when the roots are deep, there is no reason to fear the wind
. Indeed, however the world may change, whatever the political or economic circumstances, the spirit and principles of Russia’s relations with African countries remain unchanged.
We are true friends and partners, always open to honest, constructive cooperation and able to listen to and understand one another
. This enables us to steadily expand cooperation across all areas, work together to find effective responses to the key challenges and threats of our time, and promote growth for all, for the benefit of our countries and peoples.
***
🥂
Allow me to propose a toast
to the African Heads of State and Leaders of African integration associations
present here;
to the further development
of comprehensive cooperation between Russia and the countries of the African continent;
to the well-being, peace and prosperity
of our countries and peoples; and
to the health
of all participants in
the Moscow Summit
.
Read in full
#RussiaAfrica

🎙
Opening remarks
by President of Russia Vladimir Putin at a meeting with President of Egypt Abdel Fattah el-Sisi on the sidelines of
the Third Russia–Africa Summit
(Moscow, October 28, 2026)
💬
Vladimir Putin:
We are grateful to you for coming to
the #RussiaAfrica Summit
. You and I were instrumental in establishing this format, holding
the First Russia–Africa Summit
in Sochi in 2019.
I remember very well how it all began. I remember asking you to take the lead in this process.
You responded so favourably and agreed to do so.
With your encouragement, one might say,
the process gained momentum
and has developed quite actively and productively.
Since then, we have achieved a great deal through our joint efforts
. The main indicator is the growth in trade between Russia and Africa. Since 2022, its
total volume has increased by 50% to exceed $27 billion
. Egypt accounts for a substantial share of this trade.
On September 11, on the sidelines of
the BRICS Summit in New Delhi
, we had
a useful exchange of views
on
the situation in the region
and
the further development of friendly ties between Russia and Egypt
.
🇷🇺
🇪🇬
The historic relations between our countries rest on the principles of mutual respect, consideration for each other’s interests and mutual assistance
. They continue to develop successfully in accordance with
the Treaty on Comprehensive Partnership and Strategic Cooperation
.
Despite regional tensions, bilateral trade continues to grow steadily.
In the first eight months of this year, it has already
increased by 14%
. In 2025, it reached a record high,
exceeding $10 billion
for the first time.
Our Joint Intergovernmental Commission is working productively
, and preparations are underway for its 16th meeting, which will take place in Egypt in 2027.
⚛️
Our flagship project to build
the El Dabaa Nuclear Power Plant
in Egypt is progressing on schedule
. On July 9,
a ceremony was held
to mark the installation of the reactor vessel at Unit 2.
More than 1.2 million Russian tourists visited Egypt in the first six months of 2026
, compared with around 1.5 million in the whole of 2025.
🤝
Today, we have a good opportunity to continue discussing
promising areas of long-term bilateral cooperation
. We will also address other issues of mutual interest.
#RussiaEgypt

🎙
Remarks
by President of Russia Vladimir Putin at a meeting with the Heads of Africa’s leading regional organisations
(Moscow, October 28, 2026)
💬
Vladimir Putin:
I would like to emphasise that, for our country, strengthening relations with pan-African associations is
a natural extension of our long-term policy of maintaining equal and mutually beneficial partnerships with African states
.
The African Union
has been and remains Russia’s key partner among regional organisations
. A three-year roadmap is in place, providing a framework for our cooperation in trade and the economy, science and technology, social affairs, humanitarian and cultural matters, as well as politics and security.
We believe it would be useful
to step up cooperation between Russian banking institutions and
the Pan-African Payment and Settlement System
established by
the African Union
and
Afreximbank
.
🤝
Russia is committed to continuing close coordination with
the African Union
on a broad range of foreign policy issues
. We remain open to dialogue on peace and security, as well as crisis resolution and prevention.
We stand ready to continue assisting our African partners in countering such common challenges and threats of our time as
terrorism, transnational crime and drug trafficking
.
☝️
Naturally, Russia is interested in developing partnerships with all the other African integration associations represented here
. Certain steps are already being taken in this direction.
In particular,
a substantial package of intergovernmental and interagency documents
on our cooperation with
the African Continental Free Trade Area
,
the Common Market for Eastern and Southern Africa
,
the East African Community
and
the Economic Community of Central African States
has been agreed
ahead of
this Summit
.
I would like to note that Russia, like African states, is deeply involved in regional integration processes
. Our country was a founding member of
the Eurasian Economic Union
, which we are successfully developing together with friendly neighbouring states and which aims to establish common markets for goods, services, capital and labour.
🌍
I would like to emphasise once again that Russia’s partnership with Africa’s regional organisations is an important addition to our bilateral relations and contacts with our African friends
. This multifaceted cooperation fully serves the interests of all our states and contributes to sustainable economic growth and prosperity for all.

item.title: ⚡️ Russia's High Commissioner for Human Rights Yana Lantratova Mine clearance is underway in
item.description: ⚡️ Russia's High Commissioner for Human Rights Yana Lantratova : Mine clearance is underway in Alyoshki along routes for humanitarian aid deliveries and the evacuation of civilians . This is essential for carrying out the humanitarian mission . We continue preparations together with my Ukrainian counterpart Dmitry Lubinets , with mediation and coordination by US First Lady Melania Trump . Ensuring safe passage along these roads so that people can leave the city is now critica l. This is where we are focusing our efforts. We continue working to implement the agreements reached, save lives and help residents. ☝️ A ceasefire has been in effect in designated areas since October 27. Both the Russian and Ukrainian sides are observing it.

🎙
Address
by President of Russia Vladimir Putin at the Plenary Session of
the Russia–Africa Economic and Humanitarian Forum
(Moscow, October 28, 2026)
Key points
:
•
The Russia–Africa Forum
, its
agenda and participants
, and its free and open dialogue fit naturally into the global transformation, the scale and depth of which can hardly be overstated.
We are witnessing a
#MultipolarWorld
truly becoming a reality, and this trend is objective and irreversible.
•
The era when the destinies of entire continents were determined by a narrow bloc of states is coming to an irrevocable end
. A fairer world is taking its place, one in which the voices of all countries participating in international affairs must be heard. New centres of global governance are emerging, becoming focal points for reshaping the world order.
•
Over the past five years, the
#BRICS
countries have accounted for more than 40% of global GDP
, while the G7’s contribution has been
less than 30%
. There is no doubt that this balance will continue to shift in favour of developing countries.
•
Africa is increasingly asserting itself as one of the poles of the global economy and politics.
The continent is experiencing a new awakening: its sovereignty is growing stronger, and its influence and standing on the world stage are increasing. Above all, Africans have an unshakeable determination to defend their interests and a desire to shape their own future and choose their own path of development.
💬
Let me recall
the words
of
Thomas Sankara
, a great son of the Burkinabe people, the first President of Burkina Faso:
Debt is neo-colonialism, in which colonizers have transformed themselves into “technical assistants”. Under its current form, controlled and dominated by imperialism, debt is a skillfully managed reconquest of Africa, intended to subjugate its growth and development through foreign rules.
•
It is no coincidence that Africa is called the continent of the future.
According to
UN projections
, from 2030 onwards, the centre of global population growth will inevitably shift to Africa – a process that is already under way. By 2050, its population will
exceed 2.5 billion
,
around 70% of whom will be young people under the age of 30
.
•
Russia is one of the most reliable guarantors of food security on the African continent
. More than
40 African countries
already receive Russian fertilisers and grain. We stand ready to further expand the geographical reach of our agricultural supplies. In the first nine months of 2026, Russia exported
13 million tonnes
of agricultural products to Africa.
•
Russia firmly maintains a leading position in the global race for technological sovereignty.
I would like to emphasise that our country is ready to share its advanced expertise and high-tech digital know-how with our African friends.
•
Our shared interest lies in improving Africans’ access to affordable, sustainable and environmentally friendly energy sources
and helping develop domestic energy markets in Africa, including in areas where Russia possesses unique technologies. This work is already under way. More than
30 promising energy projects
are being jointly implemented in
16 African countries
.
•
Since 2020, the number of African students studying in Russia has increased by 50%
, while the number of Russian scholarships for Africa has
almost tripled
. A record number of citizens of African countries –
around 40,000
– are studying at Russian universities. For the 2026-2027 academic year, the scholarship quota has been increased
to 5,500 places
.
❗️
Russia is sincerely interested in further developing and deepening trade, economic and humanitarian cooperation with all African countries in every possible way.

#RussiaAfrica
